name: OBS Studio
author: Control It Team
subtitle: Video Switcher & Streaming Control
descriptionText: Control scenes, sources, audio, streaming, and recording on OBS Studio 28+ via direct persistent WebSocket connection with instant tally feedback.

setupFields.label: OBS Host / IP
setupFields.helpText: Enter the IP address of the computer running OBS Studio.

setupFields.label: WebSocket Port
setupFields.helpText: Standard OBS WebSocket v5 port is 4455.

setupFields.label: WebSocket Password
setupFields.helpText: Found in OBS Studio under Tools > WebSocket Server Settings.

actions.title: OBS: Switch Scene
actions.subtitle: Change active program scene
actions.descriptionText: Switches OBS Studio to the designated scene name.

actions.title: OBS: Toggle Streaming
actions.subtitle: Start or stop live broadcast
actions.descriptionText: Toggles streaming output in OBS Studio.

actions.title: OBS: Toggle Recording
actions.subtitle: Start or stop local recording
actions.descriptionText: Toggles recording state in OBS Studio.

actions.title: OBS: Toggle Audio Mute
actions.subtitle: Mute or unmute audio source
actions.descriptionText: Toggles mute status for a specified microphone or audio source.

actions.title: OBS: Get Current Scene
actions.subtitle: Query active program scene
actions.descriptionText: Queries the active program scene name in OBS Studio with live title feedback.

actions.title: OBS: Get Streaming Status
actions.subtitle: Query live stream state
actions.descriptionText: Queries whether OBS Studio is currently live streaming.

actions.title: OBS: Get Recording Status
actions.subtitle: Query local recording state
actions.descriptionText: Queries whether OBS Studio is currently recording locally.

actions.title: OBS: Get Audio Mute Status
actions.subtitle: Query input mute status
actions.descriptionText: Queries audio mute status for a specified microphone or audio source.
